description: Cross-referencing terrestrial extreme field environments against Lunar and Martian surface realities for mission architectures, instrumentation calibration, and traversability validation.

pillars.name: Geomorphology & Topography
pillars.scope: Evaluates terrain shape, roughness, landing safety, and traversability.

pillars.name: Mineralogy & Geochemistry
pillars.scope: Evaluates composition for drill tests, spectrometers, and ISRU potential.

pillars.name: Subsurface & Geophysics
pillars.scope: Evaluates underground structures for radiation shielding and habitats.

pillars.name: Thermal Environment
pillars.scope: Evaluates thermal extremes for extravehicular suits, batteries, and habitats.

pillars.name: Atmospheric & Aeolian Processes
pillars.scope: Evaluates wind shaping, dust transport, aridity, and radiation exposure.

pillars.name: Astrobiology & Habitability
pillars.scope: Evaluates extreme survival limits and biosignature preservation models.
